annotations.title: List acts registered in a date window

description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. EVERY held act (teisės aktas) the register REGISTERED between two dates, newest first, with the exact total and counts by issuer, page by page (`next_cursor`). Use it for 'what was published in TAR yesterday': new orders of a ministry (issuer='SADM'), the Government's resolutions, an inspectorate's rules. search_law RANKS provisions by a question; this lists acts by registration date. A window past the newest feed says so.

act_types.description: Optional act types: `Įsakymas`, `Nutarimas`, `Įstatymas` ... (a word of the type is enough).
act_types.title: Act Types

cursor.description: Pass the previous answer's next_cursor to read the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

issuer.description: Optional word of the issuing body as the register writes it: `SADM`, `Vyriausybė`, `darbo inspekcija` (case and accents ignored).
issuer.title: Issuer

limit.description: Acts per page, default 50, at most 200; read on with `cursor` until next_cursor is empty.
limit.title: Limit

registered_from.description: First registration day (YYYY-MM-DD) - the day the register (TAR) registered the act.
registered_from.title: Registered From

registered_to.description: Last registration day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive; defaults to registered_from (one day).
registered_to.title: Registered To

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: list_acts
title: List acts registered in a date window
